import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static int n, maxTime, startX, startY;
    static String[] labMap = new String[20];
    static String[] sciMap = new String[20];
    static int[][][][][] memo = new int[12][12][12][12][62];
    static int[][] cap = new int[250][250];
    static int[] parent = new int[250];
    static int[][] dist = new int[20][20];
    static int[][] visited = new int[20][20];
    
    static final int[] dx = {1, -1, 0, 0};
    static final int[] dy = {0, 0, 1, -1};
    
    static boolean inRange(int x, int y) {
        return x >= 0 && x < n && y >= 0 && y < n && labMap[x].charAt(y) != 'Y' && labMap[x].charAt(y) != 'Z';
    }
    
    static void computeDist() {
        for (int i = 0; i < 20; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < 20; j++) {
                dist[i][j] = 0x3f3f3f3f;
                visited[i][j] = 0;
            }
        }
        dist[startX][startY] = 0;
        visited[startX][startY] = 1;
        Queue<Integer> qx = new LinkedList<>();
        Queue<Integer> qy = new LinkedList<>();
        qx.add(startX);
        qy.add(startY);
        while (!qx.isEmpty()) {
            int x = qx.poll();
            int y = qy.poll();
            for (int k = 0; k < 4; ++k) {
                int nx = x + dx[k];
                int ny = y + dy[k];
                if (inRange(nx, ny) && visited[nx][ny] == 0) {
                    dist[nx][ny] = dist[x][y] + 1;
                    visited[nx][ny] = 1;
                    qx.add(nx);
                    qy.add(ny);
                }
            }
        }
    }
    
    static boolean checkPath(int x0, int y0, int x1, int y1, int step) {
        if (step > maxTime) return false;
        int val = memo[x0][y0][x1][y1][step];
        if (val != -1) return val == 1;
        if (x0 == x1 && y0 == y1) {
            memo[x0][y0][x1][y1][step] = (dist[x0][y0] >= step) ? 1 : 0;
            return dist[x0][y0] >= step;
        }
        if (dist[x0][y0] <= step) {
            memo[x0][y0][x1][y1][step] = 0;
            return false;
        }
        for (int k = 0; k < 4; ++k) {
            int nx = x0 + dx[k];
            int ny = y0 + dy[k];
            if (inRange(nx, ny) && checkPath(nx, ny, x1, y1, step + 1)) {
                memo[x0][y0][x1][y1][step] = 1;
                return true;
            }
        }
        memo[x0][y0][x1][y1][step] = 0;
        return false;
    }
    
    static boolean bfs(int src, int dst) {
        Arrays.fill(parent, -1);
        parent[src] = -2;
        Queue<Integer> q = new LinkedList<>();
        q.add(src);
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int u = q.poll();
            for (int v = src; v <= dst; ++v) {
                if (parent[v] == -1 && cap[u][v] > 0) {
                    parent[v] = u;
                    q.add(v);
                }
            }
        }
        return parent[dst] != -1;
    }
    
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        n = sc.nextInt();
        maxTime = sc.nextInt();
        sc.nextLine();
        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) sciMap[i] = sc.nextLine();
        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) labMap[i] = sc.nextLine();
        
        List<int[]> coords = new ArrayList<>();
        List<Integer> labCap = new ArrayList<>();
        List<Integer> sciCap = new ArrayList<>();
        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; ++j) {
                if (sciMap[i].charAt(j) == 'Z') {
                    startX = i;
                    startY = j;
                } else if (Character.isDigit(sciMap[i].charAt(j))) {
                    coords.add(new int[]{i, j});
                    labCap.add(labMap[i].charAt(j) - '0');
                    sciCap.add(sciMap[i].charAt(j) - '0');
                }
            }
        }
        
        int m = coords.size();
        for (int i = 0; i < 250; i++) {
            Arrays.fill(cap[i], 0);
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < m; ++i) {
            cap[0][i + 1] = sciCap.get(i);
            cap[m + 1 + i][2 * m + 1] = labCap.get(i);
        }
        
        computeDist();
        for (int i = 0; i < 12; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < 12; j++) {
                for (int k = 0; k < 12; k++) {
                    for (int l = 0; l < 12; l++) {
                        for (int s = 0; s < 62; s++) {
                            memo[i][j][k][l][s] = -1;
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < m; ++i) {
            for (int j = 0; j < m; ++j) {
                if (checkPath(coords.get(i)[0], coords.get(i)[1], coords.get(j)[0], coords.get(j)[1], 0)) {
                    cap[i + 1][m + 1 + j] = 1000;
                }
            }
        }
        
        int maxFlow = 0;
        while (bfs(0, 2 * m + 1)) {
            int sink = 2 * m + 1;
            int flow = 1000000;
            while (parent[sink] >= 0) {
                flow = Math.min(flow, cap[parent[sink]][sink]);
                sink = parent[sink];
            }
            sink = 2 * m + 1;
            while (parent[sink] >= 0) {
                cap[parent[sink]][sink] -= flow;
                cap[sink][parent[sink]] += flow;
                sink = parent[sink];
            }
            maxFlow += flow;
        }
        
        System.out.println(maxFlow);
    }
}
